lines.en: A warm current slides past my fin; perfect.
I cruise above the seabed without stirring sand.

lines.zh: 头两侧的眼睛，各看一边。
lines.en: An eye on each side of my head, I watch both ways.

lines.zh: 绕一圈，再绕一圈，不着急。
lines.en: One circle, then another; there is no hurry.
Coral shadows slide beneath me.
One flick of my tail outruns your boat.
The shoal of tropical fish scatters ahead.

lines.zh: 水里没有路，我走的是角度。
lines.en: There are no roads in water; I travel by angles.

lines.zh: 鱿鱼的墨还没散，就在前头。
lines.en: Squid ink still hangs in the water ahead.

lines.zh: 锤形的头，转起来最省力。
lines.en: My hammer head turns with the least effort.
The shallows run warm, and fish gather there.
I do not chase straight lines; I cut across.
Seagrass brushes my belly, soft as cloth.
Sink a little and the light dims.

lines.zh: 我侧过头，把整片礁扫了一遍。
lines.en: I tilt my head and sweep the whole reef once.

lines.zh: 伤鱼的血丝在水里拉得长，我顺着它走。
lines.en: An injured fish's blood trails long in the water, and I follow it.
The warm current turns and I turn with it.

lines.zh: 我这两眼分得开，看得广。
lines.en: Eyes wide apart — I see everything.

lines.zh: 脑袋两边有眼睛，你却只看见一个我。
lines.en: Eyes on both sides; you only see one of me.
I hear the surface clearly.

lines.zh: 让开，我要潜到礁石的影子里。
lines.en: Move, I am diving into the shadow of the reef.

lines.zh: 我这颗头，闻得到沙里的鱼。
lines.en: This head of mine smells fish under the sand.

lines.zh: 谁把沙扬起来，遮了我的侧线？
lines.en: Who stirred the sand and blinded my lateral line?
The warm current carries me on patrol.
One sweep of my head scatters the fish.

lines.zh: 暖水里游过一片，我就不停。
lines.en: Once past these warm shallows, I don't stop.

lines.zh: 跟紧我的尾鳍，别在珊瑚口迷路。
lines.en: Stay on my tail fin and do not get lost at the coral mouth.

lines.zh: 远处那股咸腥，顺着流过来。
lines.en: That far salty reek rides the current here.

lines.zh: 这条海底的路，我闭着眼也认得。
lines.en: I know this seabed path with my eyes shut.

lines.zh: 今天的暖流，比昨日薄了一层。
lines.en: The warm current runs thinner than yesterday.

lines.zh: 这股暗流老是推歪我的头。
lines.en: This undercurrent keeps pushing my head off line.

lines.zh: 水面的光晃得我眼发花。
lines.en: The light on the surface makes my eyes swim.
Water passes my gills, one beat at a time.

lines.zh: 悬在这儿，等一条受伤的鱼。
lines.en: I hover here, waiting for a wounded fish.
A hint of blood, still far away.

lines.zh: 鱿鱼喜欢躲石缝，我知道。
lines.en: Squid like rock crevices; I know that.
One tooth loosened; another will grow.

lines.zh: 头摆正，水就从两侧滑开。
lines.en: Head level, water slips past both sides.
I have circled this reef for many years.
When the warm current stops, the fish leave.
I do not sleep; I simply slow down.
That fish in the distance is bleeding.

lines.zh: 身上的旧疤，是礁石留的。
lines.en: An old scar on my flank came from rock.
If the water cools, I head south.

lines.zh: 海面在头顶晃，像块碎玻璃。
lines.en: The surface shifts overhead like broken glass.
I move only when the current changes.

lines.zh: 海草慢慢摇，摇得我眼皮沉。
lines.en: The seagrass sways so slowly my eyelids grow heavy.

lines.zh: 鳃边冒个泡，破了，再冒一个。
lines.en: A bubble leaves my gills, pops, and another follows.

lines.zh: 顶上漏下一小块光，照见沙纹。
lines.en: A small patch of light falls through and shows the sand ripples.

lines.zh: 海夜里，只有我的尾巴在动。
lines.en: In the sea night only my tail moves.

lines.zh: 潮水推了三次，我一次没挪。
lines.en: The tide pushed three times and I did not budge.

lines.zh: 礁后面冒出一串泡，是谁？
lines.en: A string of bubbles behind the reef, who is there?

lines.zh: 沙上映出我的锤头，它在看我。
lines.en: My hammer head is mirrored in the sand, watching me.

lines.zh: 又一尾小鱼游过，我忘了数到几。
lines.en: Another fish passes and I forget the count again.

lines.zh: 我悬在礁口，等一群小鱼经过。
lines.en: I hover at the reef mouth, waiting for a school.

lines.zh: 我今天想吃章鱼，还是鱼？
lines.en: Should I eat octopus today, or fish?

lines.zh: 暖水海洋里，只有水流在响。
lines.en: In the warm sea, only the current speaks.

lines.zh: 就这样悬在礁影里，不坏。
lines.en: Hovering in the reef shadow like this is not bad.

lines.zh: 我这颗头，两边都能看见你。
lines.en: With this head, both sides of me see you.

lines.zh: 这只横着的头，能扫到沙下的鱼。
lines.en: This wide head sweeps fish from the sand.

lines.zh: 你刚才碰破了皮，我闻到了。
lines.en: You scraped yourself; I caught the scent.
You stand too upright in the water.

lines.zh: 你的心跳，我从这儿听得见。
lines.en: I can hear your heartbeat from here.

lines.zh: 那条腿在划水，我看得清。
lines.en: That leg is kicking, and I see it clearly.
You are hurt, which makes this simpler.
What is in your hand? A fish?
I circle above you; do not look up.
The water clouds, yet your outline remains.
You swim well enough, only slowly.
I patrol this reef; you are passing through.

lines.zh: 你呼出的泡，比我鳃边的大一圈。
lines.en: Your bubbles come a size bigger than mine.

lines.zh: 你把我看清了？我两头都看着你。
lines.en: You see me now? Both ends of my head see you.
You do not smell like warm water.

lines.zh: 你会游，但拐弯不如我这把头。
lines.en: You can swim, but you cannot turn like this head.

lines.zh: 你身上有干沙和太阳味。
lines.en: You smell of dry sand and sun.

lines.zh: 你挡住了暖水里的那片亮。
lines.en: You block that glimmer in the warm water.

lines.zh: 你一动，水里的电味就乱了。
lines.en: When you move, the electric taste of the water muddles.

lines.zh: 我脑袋两边的眼睛，都看见那点亮。
lines.en: The eyes on both sides of my head see that glint.

lines.zh: 你别下水，我不上岸，成交？
lines.en: You stay out, I stay in, agreed?

lines.zh: 你划水的样子，像块沉木。
lines.en: You paddle like a sinking log.
My hide is cartilage; your blade slipped.
Now I remember which way that came from.

lines.zh: 你打中我的鳃，算你有本事。
lines.en: You hit my gills; that took some skill.
Turning in water is slow; be patient.
It hurts, but the blood smell wakes me.
Another tooth gone; I do not mind.
Back off a little; I need to circle.
That cut was not deep enough.
A tear in my fin, and I still swim.
I have your position marked.
Water flooded my gills; I cannot breathe.
I cruise sideways through warm water.
My teeth are still even, so keep back.
My gills were not open yet when you struck.
A scale drifted away, do not pick it up.
You hit my flank, where the bone is thin.

lines.zh: 往上游一点，鳃里全是沙。
lines.en: A little higher, my gills are full of sand.

lines.zh: 暖水海洋里没人咬过我。
lines.en: Nothing in the warm sea has bitten me.
Blood in the warm water, bitter and fishy.

lines.zh: 得钻进那块礁的阴影里。
lines.en: I need to slide into that rock shadow.

lines.zh: 鱿鱼的味道，从你袋里出来。
lines.en: Squid smell is leaking from your bag.
Tropical fish? Drop it and I will take it.

lines.zh: 你举着鱼不动，是想让我靠近。
lines.en: You hold the fish still, hoping I come close.

lines.zh: 受伤的鱼最好，活的也行。
lines.en: Wounded fish are best, though live will do.

lines.zh: 别把手伸进水里，会少一节。
lines.en: Keep your hand out of the water, or lose a finger.

lines.zh: 血流进水里，比什么饵都灵。
lines.en: Blood in the water beats any bait.
Step back, and I will swim over.
The fish must be fresh, not sun-dried.

lines.zh: 这么小的鱼，一口就没了。
lines.en: A fish that small disappears in one bite.
I do not eat hands; I eat fish.
Squid ink is drifting toward me.

lines.zh: 我把头一横，气味更清楚了。
lines.en: I turn my head sideways and the scent sharpens.

lines.zh: 鱿鱼的味道……可你手里有铁。
lines.en: Squid smell, but you are holding iron.

lines.zh: 这颗锤头，能嗅到沙里的鱼。
lines.en: This hammer head smells fish in the sand.
My gills are flared, so I admit it.

lines.zh: 你手里那块鱼，掰一半给我。
lines.en: That fish in your hand, break me off half.
Who scattered fish chunks all along here?

lines.zh: 暖水海洋里，我的头就是锤。
lines.en: In warm seas, my head is the hammer.

lines.zh: 那鱼的味道，我隔着水闻到。
lines.en: I smell that fish through the water.

lines.zh: 暖海里，鱿鱼跑不过我的鼻子。
lines.en: In warm seas, squid can't outrun my nose.
One bump and you tumble over.
I weigh far more than I look.
This cartilage body takes no damage.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲在水里碍事吧。
lines.en: That armor must be a nuisance underwater.
Give me half an arm's width; I cannot pass.

lines.zh: 鳍扫过你，只是打个招呼。
lines.en: My fin brushing you is only a greeting.
Do not grab my back; it will cut you.
I displaced the current; steady yourself.

lines.zh: 这一下不算攻击，下一记算。
lines.en: That was not an attack; the next one is.
You were touched only because you moved slowly.
Who bumped me? Never mind, the fish matter.
You scuffed my whole row of scales.

lines.zh: 你压过来，我整条都歪了。
lines.en: You leaned in and bent my whole body.

lines.zh: 你站在流里，鱼都绕道了。
lines.en: You stand in the current and the fish detour.

lines.zh: 下次从我的背后游过去。
lines.en: Next time swim around behind me.
This wide hammer head knocks you askew.
The coral tips are in my fin now.

lines.zh: 你走你的浅滩，我巡我的礁。
lines.en: You keep the shallows and I patrol my reef.

lines.zh: 我的背鳍被你撞折了一角。
lines.en: You bent a corner of my dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 撞得我侧过身，肚皮朝天。
lines.en: You knocked me on my side, belly to the sky.
The warm season is here; meet me past the reef.

lines.zh: 我们并着游，鳍几乎碰到。
lines.en: We swim side by side, fins almost touching.

lines.zh: 绕圈的时候，别撞上珊瑚。
lines.en: While circling, mind the coral.

lines.zh: 你从左边来，我从右边接。
lines.en: Come from the left; I will meet you on the right.
Where the water pales is a good spot.
Beat your tail slower and follow me.

lines.zh: 这片海床很平，没有暗流。
lines.en: This seabed is flat, with no hidden current.

lines.zh: 一起游，鱼群会自己让开。
lines.en: Swim together and the shoals part for us.

lines.zh: 明年这条暖流，还在这儿。
lines.en: Next year this warm current will still be here.
Do not leave yet; one more circle.
Nobody touches these eggs.

lines.zh: 顺着暖流，我们游到光变白。
lines.en: We ride the warm current until the light turns white.

lines.zh: 我这颗横着的头，能看见两边。
lines.en: This wide head sees both sides.
Along the warm reef, we swim side by side.

lines.zh: 眼睛长在锤子两头，看得更宽。
lines.en: My eyes sit at both ends of the hammer.

lines.zh: 你背上的鳞，在暖水里泛蓝。
lines.en: The scales on your back shine blue in the warm water.

lines.zh: 看你游过来，我心都软了。
lines.en: Watching you swim over, my heart softens.

lines.zh: 暖水海洋里，我们绕着礁石转。
lines.en: In the warm sea we circle the reef together.
Will you swim beside me along the sand?

lines.zh: 把头贴过来，让我们并鳍。
lines.en: Bring your head close and let our fins touch.
This tooth fell out; I take it back.

lines.zh: 鱿鱼的触手还动，收下了。
lines.en: The squid tentacle still moves; I keep it.
The tooth is yours; it makes a fine arrow.
A bone on the seabed, I carry for fun.
This scale glints, so I take it.
What sinks belongs to whatever lies below.
Carried between my teeth, it rides steadier than hands.
Who dropped this fish? It is mine now.
I have nosed through that wreck already.
One bite to test how soft it is.

lines.zh: 沉在沙上的东西，还带着铁腥。
lines.en: Something sunk into the sand, still stinking of iron.

lines.zh: 这个亮片，正好嵌我的巢口。
lines.en: This shiny bit fits my nest entrance exactly.

lines.zh: 这是你的吧，我用嘴推回去。
lines.en: This must be yours, I will nudge it back.
Under a rock? One push with my head.

lines.zh: 嘴里这块，坠得我往下沉。
lines.en: This in my mouth is dragging me down.

lines.zh: 沙里闪了一下，是我先嗅到的。
lines.en: Something glinted in the sand and I smelled it first.

lines.zh: 掉在珊瑚缝里，我叼出来归我。
lines.en: Dropped in a coral crack, so what I pull out is mine.

lines.zh: 锤头一扫，前面的鱼就散。
lines.en: One sweep of my hammer head, and the fish scatter.

lines.zh: 这玩意换两条鱼，应该够。
lines.en: This should trade for two fish.
This bone will do for my teeth, so I keep it.
You are bleeding, and you cannot flee fast.
That fish is only half alive.
The weaker the prey, the sooner I arrive.
You turned, and the angle is perfect.
I am in no hurry; two circles first.
There is iron-tang in the water.
You stop to gasp; that is my signal.
The next bite comes from your flank.

lines.zh: 你身上的伤，替我指了路。
lines.en: Your wound has pointed the way for me.

lines.zh: 退到礁石边，你就没路了。
lines.en: Back to the rocks, and you run out of room.

lines.zh: 暖流推着我，正好压过去。
lines.en: The warm current pushes me right onto you.
I have an eye on each side of this head.

lines.zh: 这锤形的头，能感到你的心跳。
lines.en: This hammer head can feel your heartbeat.
That one over the sand, stop flicking your tail.

lines.zh: 鱿鱼的味道，从礁石那边来。
lines.en: Squid smell, from beyond the reef.
That heap of stones? It's me.

lines.zh: 锤头上的眼睛全对准了。
lines.en: Every eye on the hammer is aimed.
First I circle, then I strike.

lines.zh: 暖水里那条鱼，脱离鱼群了。
lines.en: That warm-water fish left its school.
That fish goes into my mouth and nowhere else.

lines.zh: 你往左，我提前到了左边。
lines.en: You go left, and I am already there.
In water you cannot dodge, only go faster.
I am beneath you, climbing slowly.
Your feet kick wildly, to no effect.
Each circle closes a little tighter.
Threads of blood stretch through the water.
Surface for air; I will be waiting.
That crevice is too narrow for you.
My hammer head is aimed; hold still.
This last stretch, I use everything.

lines.zh: 绕了这么多圈，尾巴还稳。
lines.en: All these circles and my tail is still steady.

lines.zh: 这一锤头下去，鱼就没影了.
lines.en: One head-butt and the fish are gone.

lines.zh: 礁口到沙沟，都是我的巡道。
lines.en: Reef mouth to sand trench, all of it is my patrol lane.
My head is a wide bow.

lines.zh: 暖水里，没人游得过我这颗头。
lines.en: In warm water nothing outswims this head.

lines.zh: 暖海里的鱼，一条都跑不掉。
lines.en: In the warm sea, no fish escapes.
When the water goes quiet, I charge.

lines.zh: 每块礁我都用头蹭过一遍。
lines.en: I have rubbed my head against every rock here.

lines.zh: 再往浅滩跑，你就搁浅了。
lines.en: Keep running shallow and you will beach yourself.

lines.zh: 我绕你第三圈了，还没咬。
lines.en: Third circle around you and I still have not bitten.
Bite down, then twist my head.
One of my teeth stayed with you.

lines.zh: 水面糊了一下，看不清了。
lines.en: The water clouds and I lose sight.
You were struck from the flank.
Cartilage does not fear your blade.
That impact should have cracked a rib.
You roll over, belly upward.
Rows of teeth fall out and regrow.

lines.zh: 我不咬第二次，除非你还动。
lines.en: I do not bite twice unless you move.
The spray clears and you are ten feet back.
The warm shallows are my hunting ground.
In warm seas I swim the steadiest.

lines.zh: 锤骨撞上来，你的肋先认输。
lines.en: My hammer hits and your ribs give in first.

lines.zh: 带着你的血，离开暖水湾。
lines.en: Take your blood out of this warm bay.
One butt of my hammerhead and bones rattle.
This metallic taste is blood.

lines.zh: 暖海里，我专挑鱿鱼下手。
lines.en: In warm seas, I go for squid.

lines.zh: 这锤形的头，专门用来撞。
lines.en: This hammer head is made for ramming.
This one is for my school.

lines.zh: 上去吧，用我的锤头送你。
lines.en: Up you go, my hammer will give you a lift.

lines.zh: 暖流把我带进这片浅海。
lines.en: The warm current carried me into these shallows.
The water is warm and the coral alive.
First a lap of the reef to learn it.
Fish are plentiful here, and so will blood be.
My hammer head breaks the surface film.
The sandy floor is flat, good for lying low.
That boat in the distance should stay away.

lines.zh: 我在这片礁出生，又回来。
lines.en: I was born on this reef, and I returned.
The seagrass sways hard; there is a current.
First, I work my teeth against each other.

lines.zh: 这水温正好，鳃一张一合。
lines.en: This water is just right, my gills open and close.

lines.zh: 我这锤头还没撞过船底。
lines.en: This hammer head has never hit a hull.
Let me circle once in the warm water.

lines.zh: 这片珊瑚，我小时候来过。
lines.en: I came to this coral when I was small.

lines.zh: 我张嘴吸水，鳃自己会算。
lines.en: I gulp water and let my gills do the counting.

lines.zh: 暖水里的鳍，还没完全醒。
lines.en: Warm-water fins, still not fully awake.

lines.zh: 我的头，像锤子扫过水面。
lines.en: My head sweeps the water like a hammer.

lines.zh: 暖水海洋里，我先绕一圈。
lines.en: In warm water, I circle once first.
Warm ocean — I've swum in.
Warm water smells of blood.
Fire underwater does not last long.

lines.zh: 我在暖水里游着，突然就热了。
lines.en: Swimming warm water, then suddenly hot.
Landing on rock hurts worse than water.
Sand scours my back — it stings.
I should not have left the water so long.
The water is gone and my hammer head is heavy.

lines.zh: 冲击波推着我翻了个身。
lines.en: The blast rolled me over once.

lines.zh: 炸得我横过头，鳃里全是响。
lines.en: The blast turned me sideways, my gills ringing.
Arrows slow in water; I can dodge them.
An arrow stuck in my cephalofoil — annoying.
That strange taste tightens my gills.
No wound, yet it feels like lightning through me.

lines.zh: 这片礁的鱼都躲起来了。
lines.en: Every fish on this reef has gone hiding.
So hungry my gills barely move.
Lightning struck the water and numbed me.

lines.zh: 暖水海洋也会被雷击穿。
lines.en: Even warm seas get pierced by lightning.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，我撑不了多久。
lines.en: There is no water here; I cannot last.

lines.zh: 脚下空空的，连海都没了。
lines.en: Nothing beneath my feet, not even sea.
